correctness.rationale: Example 5.1 gives a nonidentity a=[x,y] that satisfies all triple-commutator equations [a,b,c]=1 in every exponent-three extension of G, and the same a has [a,v,w] nontrivial in A coproduct F_2. Each source group embeds in a model of the model companion. Both images have order 3, hence the same parameter-free quantifier-free one-type because every one-variable group term is a power. Their disagreement on the second-center formula proves non-QE. The standard universal-theory model-completion theorem then gives non-model-completion.

value.rationale: The result identifies a sharp structural limit of a new model-companion theorem: the theory is model complete, complete, and decidable, but not quantifier eliminating or a model completion. The obstruction already appears with one free variable and is witnessed by the natural second-center predicate, giving a concrete definability boundary rather than a generic appeal to nonamalgamation.
